scripts.dev:client: npm run build --workspace @glix/shared && npm run dev --workspace @glix/client
scripts.dev:server: npm run build --workspace @glix/shared && npm run dev --workspace @glix/server
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @glix/shared && npm run build --workspace @glix/client && npm run build --workspace @glix/server

scripts.test:engine: npm run build --workspace @glix/shared && node --test packages/shared/dist/engine.test.js packages/shared/dist/games.test.js packages/shared/dist/games-stage7.test.js packages/shared/dist/games-stage8.test.js packages/shared/dist/games-stage9.test.js packages/shared/dist/catalog-stage10.test.js
